nom: The INKEY List Beta Hydroxy Acid Blemish + Blackhead Serum

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers describe reduced shine, smaller pores and less oiliness overnight, with one noting no breakouts and less oil after long-term daily use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely report no irritation, dryness or reaction, including on rosacea-prone and allergy-flared skin, though one pale, easily-reddening reviewer says it only stays non-irritating if not paired with other harsh products.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin (oily T-zone) says the product sinks in without stickiness and calls it a game changer for oily areas.
segments.mature: One 35-year-old reviewer with acne-prone mature skin calls it affordable and effective for her skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer says the serum does not dry out her skin and leaves it feeling neither tight nor dry.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers report blackheads on the nose and chin becoming smaller, less visible or fully drawn out, often after 2-4 weeks of use; two reviewers say it did not budge their blackheads at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers describe fewer breakouts, faster healing of spots overnight or within days, and better-controlled hormonal or cystic acne; a few report new small breakouts or a big painful pimple when starting, attributed by some to purging.
concerns.oiliness: Several oily-skin reviewers say the product reduces shine and excess oil over time; one reviewer says it made her skin oily and shiny in the short term, which is why she only used it at night.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea-prone, breakout-prone skin reports no issues, and another pale, sensitive-skin reviewer says it does not cause redness or blotchiness as long as it is not combined with other harsh products.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin generally report no irritation or dryness, though one reviewer explicitly ties good tolerance to not layering it with other actives too soon.
concerns.aging: No mature-specific effect beyond acne control is described; the one mature reviewer discusses acne rather than lines or firmness.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers state the serum does not dry out the skin or leave it feeling tight; one instead reports increased hydration and plumpness.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way
Bottle size too small for price
Batch inconsistency in color and smell

extraits.texte: i bought this to unclog my skin and while it does brighten my face, i did break out with a big hurtful pimple on my cheek. i know it takes time for these kinds of serums to do its job but im hoping the breakout wasn't from this (i was using another essence with this but stopped since the breakout to see what it was that caused it). finally, IT STINKS!!!! like expired milk or vomit! like what is up with that! also this feels kind of heavy on my skin and makes it very oily/shiny which is why i only put it on in the PM.

I switched over to this BHA from a different brand bc I wanted less of the cream type serums, and the price point and clear gel of this one seemed promising. I've got persistent acne and pretty oily skin so a good bha is indispensable This has been so nice. It doesn't irritate, it makes my skin feel so nice just after putting it on, and it absorbs quickly without making me feel all sticky. And when I wake up in the morning I can see a decrease in my general blemishes and such. So good. My only complaint: it's so little. Please Inkey PLEASE make a jumbo size tube. I get two of these little ones at a time and it still feels like it goes so fast! The little one is nice for travel, but I wouldn't mind a big honking tube. If you want to make a gallon size I'll buy it, no question.
My sensitive skin loves this exfoliator, I use it twice a week and I can see an incredible difference! My skin is not tight and hormonal breakouts are visibly reduced.

extraits.titre: No issues with my rosacea-prone skin
extraits.texte: I started using this product recently, so a bit early to judge the full result, but it seems that the serum helps to slow down the blackheads apparition. The pores however do not seem shrunk, so I suggest adding a dedicated toner product for that purpose. One big positive side is that I can use the product without any issues on my rosacea breakouts-prone skin.

i find my skin is much smoother, clearer and less oily the morning after use ( i use this at night ) and as long as not paired with other harsh products so soon it doesn't irritate the skin and this is great for me considering i'm super pale and have very sensitive skin so it's very easy for my skin to look red and blotchy.

extraits.titre: simple product that is highly effective
extraits.texte: I struggle with frequent breakouts, especially on the cheeks and jawline area. I've also got sensitive skin that reacts badly to most skincare products. I've tried many products and this one clears up my skin the fastest. I even noticed a huge difference overnight. I recommend using this or the Salicylic Acid Cleanser, which also helped my skin a lot.
I really wished this would work for me but it didn't. I still have blackheads that just won't budge it is frustrating.... I liked the texture more than the paulas choice one though.
